rows.grounds: fused directional compound/read as pūrvāt + paścāt + udīcyantam (sandhi fusion marked in surface by sequence); indicates measuring/layout direction across east, west, toward north
fused form mānayet + sakalasthalam; optative/injunctive instruction to measure the whole site/ground (sthala)

items.question: What directional measurement of the entire site is prescribed for laying out the described forms?
premises: The verse gives a directional span from east through west toward north.
The instruction requires measuring the whole ground of the site.
This measurement frames placement of the previously described sectional forms.
items.inference: The ritual layout is to be measured across the full ground by extending from the eastern side through the western side toward the northern direction.
uncertainties: Exact technical mapping of udīcyantam to a precise northern boundary in this manual is not specified here.
items.plain_english: From the east through the west toward the north, one should measure out the entire ground.
